en.title: Moana Star Catherine Laga'aia Embraces 'Nepo Baby' Label With Pride
en.summary: The 19-year-old actress stepping into the iconic role of Moana is openly discussing her family's industry influence. She's ready to make her own mark on the beloved Disney character.
en.body:
The anticipation for Disney's live-action **Moana** is palpable, and at its heart is newcomer **Catherine Laga’aia**. At just 19, she’s taking on one of Disney’s most cherished heroines, a role that carries immense weight and expectation. But **Laga’aia** is approaching the spotlight with a candidness that’s already turning heads, particularly regarding her family's deep roots in the entertainment industry.

When the topic of “nepo babies” arises, **Laga’aia** doesn’t shy away. She readily acknowledges the advantage of having a father like **Jay Laga’aia**, an actor known for his roles in the **Star Wars** universe. Rather than viewing it as a stigma, she embraces it with a sense of humor and pride. 

> “I inherited nepotism, that's for sure. I'll take that anytime,” she joked, referring to her famous dad, Jay Laga’aia.

This open attitude suggests a confidence in her own abilities and a willingness to let her performance speak for itself. It’s a mature perspective for someone making their feature film debut, especially in a role as significant as Moana. The film, set to release on July 10, 2026, will see **Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson** also reprising his role as Maui, adding another layer of star power to the production.

## A New Generation of Disney Royalty

For many young actors, landing a role in a Disney live-action remake is a dream come true, a true rite of passage. **Catherine Laga’aia** is no exception. Her perspective on her family’s influence is not one of entitlement, but rather a recognition of the opportunities and guidance it has provided. She’s proud of the legacy her family has built and is eager to contribute her own chapter to it. This genuine enthusiasm, coupled with her bold stance on the “nepo baby” label, sets her apart and generates significant goodwill.


## The Fan Connection

Fans of **Moana** are understandably excited to see the beloved story brought to life in live-action. The casting of **Catherine Laga’aia** has sparked considerable discussion, and her open embrace of her family’s industry connections has resonated positively with many. This transparency fosters a connection with the audience, allowing them to see **Laga’aia** not just as a product of Hollywood connections, but as a young artist ready to prove her talent. Her willingness to be upfront about her background likely endears her to a global audience that values authenticity. It’s a refreshing approach that invites viewers to root for her success on her own merits.

## What’s Next for Moana

The live-action **Moana** is slated for release on July 10, 2026. Audiences can look forward to seeing **Catherine Laga’aia** bring the adventurous Polynesian princess to life, alongside **Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson** as Maui. Further details about the film’s supporting cast and plot developments are expected to be revealed in the coming months.

content_raw: The 19-year-old actress is making her feature film debut as one of Disney's most beloved characters in the live-action 'Moana.' Even with the support of her mom and actor dad, landing the lead role still seemed surreal to Laga'aia.
